overview: VisionTrim proposes a training-free framework for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) that accelerates inference via unified vision token compression using Dominant Vision Token Selection (DVTS) and Text-Guided Vision Complement (TGVC) modules across both vision encoding and LLM decoding stages.

modules.name: Multimodal Input Pipeline
modules.description: Preprocesses raw image, video, and text inputs, handling tokenization, image transformation, and frame sampling to generate token sequences and attention masks suitable for the MLLM forward pass.

modules.name: Global Semantic Scoring Module
modules.description: Extracts attention distributions from the [CLS] token in the Vision Encoder or the first generated token in the LLM to compute the global semantic importance score for each visual token.

modules.name: Local Affinity Measurement Module (LTAM)
modules.description: Implements the Local Token Affinity Measurement algorithm, utilizing a dual-kernel function to evaluate feature similarity and positional proximity among spatial neighbors for local spatial continuity scoring.

modules.name: Adaptive Token Selector
modules.description: Combines global semantic scores and local affinity scores using an adaptive variance-based weighting scheme, then selects the top-K dominant visual tokens while discarding the rest.

modules.name: Text-Guided Center Identifier
modules.description: Calculates cross-modal similarity between discarded visual tokens and text instructions using the text encoder, and identifies the top-R visual tokens with the highest relevance as clustering centers.

modules.name: Token Clustering & Aggregation Module
modules.description: Assigns remaining discarded tokens to the identified centers based on text-guided similarity scores and aggregates them via weighted averaging to generate complement tokens, iterating to refine clusters.

modules.name: Vision Encoder Integration Hook
modules.description: Intercepts the output of the vision encoder to apply DVTS and TGVC operations, reducing the visual token sequence length before passing the compact representation to the projector and LLM.

modules.name: LLM Decoder Integration Hook
modules.description: Inserts DVTS and TGVC operations between specific transformer layers within the LLM decoding stage, dynamically pruning and merging visual tokens while maintaining cross-modal alignment with text tokens.

modules.name: Unified Inference Engine
modules.description: Orchestrates the complete forward propagation loop of the MLLM, ensuring the correct sequential execution of vision encoding, projection, and LLM decoding with token compression applied at specified stages.

modules.name: Model Efficiency Profiler
modules.description: Calculates theoretical FLOPs reduction, measures end-to-end inference latency and prefill time (CUDA time), and monitors KV cache memory usage to quantify the acceleration and resource savings.

modules.name: Multimodal Accuracy Evaluator
modules.description: Computes performance metrics such as Accuracy, Score (for captioning), and specific benchmark scores (e.g., MME perception/cognition) across various visual question answering and understanding tasks.

modules.name: Image Benchmark Executor
modules.description: Manages the execution of evaluation scripts on standard image-based benchmarks (e.g., GQA, MMBench, POPE) and high-resolution settings, collecting predictions and calculating metrics.

modules.name: Video Benchmark Executor
modules.description: Manages the execution of evaluation scripts on video-based benchmarks (e.g., TGIF, MSVD, ActivityNet), handling frame-level token compression and temporal redundancy considerations.

modules.name: Ablation Experiment Controller
modules.description: Configures and executes ablation studies, including component-wise analysis (DVTS/TGVC on/off), ensemble strategy variations, inserted layer selection, and sensitivity analysis for different token retention ratios.
